pricingReview.findings: Compared Standard rates on both official tables. GPT-6 Luna is $0.10 input, $0.01 cached and $0.50 output per million short-context tokens. Listed GPT-6.2 and GPT-5.6 route prices match. GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst image input/output is $8/$30 per million. Gemini 3.8 Flash is $0.75/$3.75 per million through December 31, 2026 and Nano Banana 2.1 is $0.0336 per 1K image. Updated reference dates. Standard and Batch are distinct.
